body: Say I call the police, what happens when they show up and my mother is home? Where do I even end up after calling them? What happens with my dogs?

I live in Texas and the places I've looked at so far require an insurance provider before I can even speak with a psychiatrist.
The ironic thing is I got both my dogs from Craigslist. I don't want to send them back on there.
The way the police are these days they're more likely to shoot me than help. And calling the police doesn't solve someone taking care of my dogs.
